generalLayout.title: General layout tour
generalLayout.description: Learn the Session sidebar, Chat Panel, station mode switcher, Workstation, dock, and app areas.

chat-panel.title: Chat Panel
chat-panel.body: This is where users have conversations with agents, review activity, and send follow-up instructions.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.body: View your own usage and runtime status here. In an organization, you can also inspect member sync status and open a member to review Codex, Claude, and Cursor usage.

station-mode-pill.title: Switch station modes
station-mode-pill.body: Use this pill to switch station modes. Desktop means My Station, your workspace. Infinity means Agent Station, the agent activity view.

dock.title: Agent Station dock
dock.body: The dock switches apps inside the station. The tour temporarily disables auto-hide so these controls stay visible.

all-tabs.title: All Tabs
all-tabs.body: The first dock icon shows all open tabs together, regardless of which workstation app owns them.

code-editor.title: Code Editor
code-editor.body: Use Code Editor for files, diffs, terminals, source control, and coding changes made during a session.

browser.title: Browser
browser.body: Use Browser for web pages, previews, app testing, and browser-based investigation alongside the chat.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: Use Projects to track work items, plans, and project state connected to the current workspace.

codeEditor.title: Code Editor tour
codeEditor.description: Learn tabs, repo and branch switching, Source Control, Git History, and the project dashboard.

tabs.title: Code Editor tabs
tabs.body: Tabs collect the files, diffs, terminals, source control views, and dashboards you open while working in the repo.

repo-selector.title: Create or switch repos
repo-selector.body: Use the repo selector to switch the active repo or add another repository or workspace.

branch-selector.title: Change branches
branch-selector.body: The branch selector shows the current Git branch and opens the branch switch or create flow for this repo.

editor-surface.title: Editor workspace
editor-surface.body: This is the main Code Editor surface. Open files, inspect diffs, run terminals, and review generated changes here.

create-tabs.title: Create new tabs
create-tabs.body: Use the plus menu in All Tabs to create terminals, browser tabs, files, dashboards, and repo utilities.

source-control.title: Git changes
source-control.body: Open Source Control to review changed files, stage or unstage work, commit, pull, push, fetch, and sync with the remote.

git-history.title: Git history
git-history.body: Git History switches Source Control into commit history mode so you can inspect previous commits and related changes.

dashboard.title: Code Editor dashboard
dashboard.body: The dashboard is the Code Editor home tab for workspaces. Use it to add repos, open repo details, and jump into project work.
